overview: An E-rank Hunter gains extraordinary abilities after a near-death experience and becomes humanity's unexpected hope against monstrous threats.
title: Solo Leveling

overview: Neven Maguire starts the new year with a new seven-part series: Neven's English Food Tour, on RTÉ One, which concentrates on the North East of England, including Newcastle, Northumberland and County Durham.
title: Neven's English Food Tour

overview: Following staff shifts and patient journeys across the hospital. Together, they tell a bigger story of Cork University Hospital on 'any given day'.
title: Any Given Day: Cork University Hospital

overview: A brand new dating show which sets one lonely heart the challenge of dating four potential suitors at their workplace. After 2 days of dating, the singleton decides if they would like to see any of the potential suitors again for a proper date away from work.
title: When Do You Get Off?

overview: The story of Jang Hui Won, a successful woman who prioritizes her career over marriage. She works late-night shifts and weekends, but one night, her life takes an unexpected turn when she impulsively becomes pregnant with the company's president and insists on marriage.
title: Positively Yours

overview: Love, though arising between two people, can only last if both families accept it, particularly the mother. There's a young woman so perfect, almost celestial, that no one dares reach for her. She has a close friend, a handsome young man who's always been by her side. He acts as her personal bodyguard, warding off ill-intentioned men. She can come and go from his home as if she were another of his mother's children. Everything takes a turn, however, when she transitions from friend to girlfriend. In his mother's eyes, she's stealing her son's love away.
title: Club Friday Theory of Love: A Mother's Mirror

overview: In Prijzenjacht, two teams led by Rob Janssen compete for great prizes. It all revolves around one question: what is something worth? Who is price-conscious enough to win?
title: Prijzenjacht

overview: A psychological drama transformed into a thriller inspired by true events. Set in the early 1990s, the story follows a young, idealistic boy who abandons his studies and joins a religious sect.
title: Niebo. Rok w piekle

overview: Mr & Mrs with Julian Clary is a revival of the classic couples quiz show, produced for ITV by Carlton Television. The series keeps the familiar format of testing how well partners know one another, but introduces a more mature, tongue-in-cheek tone. Fronted by Julian Clary, the show features playful innuendo and mischievous humour, offering a late-night, adult-leaning twist on the traditionally family-friendly original.
title: Mr & Mrs with Julian Clary
Kantan na Oshigoto desu. Ni obo shite Mita

overview: Xie Cizhou, Lord of Yunzhou City, once rose to power with the support of Huanhua Valley, but his growing suspicion drove him into enmity with its master, Siyu, forcing the valley into seclusion from the martial world. Years later, Xie Cizhou's tyrannical rule sparks widespread resentment. In secret, his younger brother, Prince Xuanping Xie Ciyuan, counters him under the hidden identity of the head of Wufeng Pavilion. Fang Muwan, a successor of Huanhua Valley, was once trapped in a case of mistaken identity and married Xie Ciyuan for three years. She ultimately escaped by faking her own death through self-immolation, returned to the valley, and ascended as its new leader. Determined to sever all ties with the past, she becomes betrothed to Shi Jiu, a shadow guard. When an unresolved assassination attempt against the head of Wufeng Pavilion resurfaces, Fang Muwan takes matters into her own hands—only to discover that beneath the pavilion master's mask stands her former husband, Xie Ciyuan. As their eyes meet once more, national hatred, familial vengeance, and unextinguished love collide. This time, will the sword in her hand be turned toward the chaos of a troubled era, or toward the heart she has never truly understood?
title: Undercover Us

overview: After completing the grueling "Physical: Asia" finale, Team Mongolia leads their Korean teammates on a Mongolian trip of outdoor challenges and culture.
title: Physical: Welcome to Mongolia

overview: A wild and unpredictable event that sees some of the biggest names in comedy wrestling against each other and some of the UK's top professional wrestlers.
title: Clash of the Comics

overview: Spillet is an intense, social and psychological game about money, power and relationships.
title: Spillet

overview: Every Friday, Mikhail Fishman presents his take on the past week. Together with key figures and analysts, Fishman attempts to understand the meaning and future direction of the key events and decisions of the previous seven days. And so it goes with Mikhail Fishman—debates and investigations, opinion pieces and dry analysis.
title: И так далее с Михаилом Фишманом

overview: The extraordinary life of Australia's most notorious bank robber, Brenden Abbott, is dramatized in this high-octane series about his unprecedented career of crime and chaotic life on the run.
title: Run

overview: "No, Your Majesty" follows James Taylor, a poor but brilliant scholarship student who enters an elite university hoping to escape poverty and build a future. Instead, he becomes the target of Prince William Davies, a spoiled, powerful heir raised under pressure and emotional neglect. Their first meeting is explosive, humiliating, and deeply charged. But as they clash, fight, and test each other's limits, their hostility slowly turns into a dangerous, magnetic attraction. Around them, the elite students scheme and manipulate — especially Linda, William's self-declared fiancée — pushing the tension even further. Between scandals, bullying, secret moments, and unexpected vulnerability, James and William are forced to face not only each other, but the truth about themselves.
title: No, Your Majesty

overview: Matt, a young grifter in the corrupt Vitarelli mafia clan, is deep in debt to his ruthless cousin Sebastian. His only way out? Spy on Marcus Gravano — a rival mafia boss known for his brutal methods and zero tolerance for betrayal. What starts as a desperate mission quickly spirals into a high-stakes seduction of power, survival, and identity. The story begins with Matt crashing into Marcus's life in a chaotic, cross-dressing escape gone wrong — and from that moment, their connection is electric. Marcus, intrigued by Matt's audacity, makes him his personal servant instead of killing him. But Matt's double life gets more dangerous when he discovers Marcus isn't just a monster — he's a man who protects what's his, and maybe that includes Matt now.
title: Wicked Game

overview: Obsessed With You follows Tino, a talented nightclub dancer trapped in a toxic world controlled by a powerful club owner. His life is ruled by fear, debt, and the desperate need to save his sick sister. Everything changes when Brendon, a police officer, crosses his path during a raid. What starts as a moment of silent help turns into a dangerous emotional bond. Love, guilt, obsession, and violence collide as Tino is forced to choose between survival and truth.
title: Obsessed With You

overview: The Waterworld of Komodo takes the you on an extraordinary voyage to one of the most beautiful places on earth. Over the course of millions of years, the archipelago around the island of Komodo, has been shaped by the forces of nature and the mechanisms of evolution. Thanks to its isolation we are still able to stand face to face with works of nature which do not exist anywhere else on earth. On land, the legendary dragons reign undisputed, whilst under the water, strong currents surge through the coral reefs which are teeming with life. The underwater world is ruled by sharks and the majestic Manta Rays. Each episode shows you both of these worlds as well as the laws of nature which govern here. Dive into this unique ecosystem and discover a region where destructive volcanoes have periodically disrupted the order of the world. ‘The Waterworld of Komodo' is an amazing journey which leads to questions about the place of man on earth.
title: Waterwold of Komodo

overview: On a single day, Keegan Deane is described as many things. His ex-wife-calls him "unreliable"; his son calls him a "pal"; most judges think he's "an outrage"; the IRS calls him a "defendant"; and to his former dealer, he's simply a "tragic loss." Brilliant, frustratingly charming and with zero filter, Keegan is one of life's great addicts. His staggering lack of discretion and inability to self-censor land him the cases that nobody else will touch, but behind that lies a resolute optimism and belief in justice that fuel his dogged determination to defend those who seem beyond redemption. He always tries to do the right thing, but at the same time struggles to save himself from the many self-destructive elements that plague his own life, such as his overindulgence of various excesses, including women and gambling.
title: Rake

overview: The lastest Formula E news and results.
title: Formula E: Sound of the Future

overview: The BRB Show is back!
title: Big Russian Boss SHOW

overview: The Thames Torso Murderer terrorised 19th-century London but escaped justice. Lucy Worsley unearths this dark and dangerous story - can she unmask a forgotten serial killer?
title: Lucy Worsley: Victorian Murder Club

overview: Sweethearts is a light-hearted British panel game hosted by Larry Grayson, where a celebrity panel tries to spot the real couple hidden among a trio of hopeful storytellers. Each set of contestants shares the same "how we met" tale but only one is genuine, and the panel must quiz them to uncover the true sweethearts. Warm, playful and gently mischievous, the ITV series mixes bluffing, romance and Grayson's trademark charm.
title: Sweethearts

overview: On the wedding night of Crown Princess Gu Qingyao, a cold-blooded assassin known as Shiyi suddenly attempts to assassinate the Crown Prince. By accident, their souls are swapped. To protect her husband, Gu Qingyao engages in a battle of wits and courage with Shiyi, as a deadly game of assassination officially begins, uncovering a thrilling power struggle between the martial world and the imperial court behind the scenes...
title: How to Train Your Killer

overview: This three-part docuseries chronicles the tragic story of Polish model Agnieszka Kotlarska, whose life was cut short by an obsessive fan.
title: Zabić Miss

overview: Hao Yu, the police superintendent's adopted daughter, goes deep undercover as an informant within the underworld and becomes the girlfriend of mob prince, Ji Jiejie. The ruthless and decisive Ji Jiejie, fully aware she is an informant, yet willingly succumbs and even gambles his life to protect her. When her former lover, police superintendent Zhou Ziheng, returns, where will they go as they navigate their path between justice, truth, and passion?
title: Turbulent Love

overview: Black Room. Closed space. The action takes place as it leisurely. You know that every word, every gesture of the characters have a special, secret, yet completely understood the meaning. But you feel: do not miss a single nuance. In each novel - two or three hero. Between them - a real drama, which ends with a bang. Sometimes figuratively and sometimes literally. Continuous: no yesterday and tomorrow. Only here and now. Sometimes the action takes place on the verge of fantasy and reality. And often the fantasies are much more realistic than real life. Black Room, or, as they say theater goers black cabinet - a space in which nothing can be seen until the light will light. Imagine a black background moving people in black velvet No, it's not a horror movie. Partly, of course, a bit scary. But that's only surge from expectations of how to resolve the situation in each novel.
title: Чёрная комната

overview: All because of a "magic crock"! Three bumbling companions embark on a journey to repair a broken jar in an attempt to cover up their blunder. Along the way, they stumble into a spy conspiracy, accidentally discover a hidden paradise, and launch an ancient startup using their trusty drain-clearing gadget. When conspiracy collides with cuisine, and romance meets ridiculousness, this lovable trio cooks up a crayfish craze that writes a hilariously unconventional legend!
title: Shrimp Encounter

overview: To save her seriously ill mother, Lin Qingzhu strikes a deal with Chu Nanhe. Little does she know that he is actually Chu Guanxing, who has been reborn. In his previous life, his obsessiveness drove Lin Qingzhu to commit suicide. Now, filled with remorse, he returns with a new identity, helping her clear away obstacles while restraining his surging love. Lin Qingzhu feels the warmth amidst his protection. When family conspiracies and the truth are unveiled, what kind of ending will the three of them ultimately face?
title: Falling Under the Stars

overview: In Watch Your Back, host Soy Kroon welcomes 12 familiar faces to his country house. In the real world, they have made a name for themselves. Here, they are nothing more than a number. That number is on their back — visible to everyone except themselves. Those who know remain in the game. What do you do when everyone knows except you?
title: Watch Your Back

overview: The ultimate musical game show where tactics and talent come together. Fifty singers try to sing better and impress more than the rest, until only one remains.
title: The Winner Takes It All

overview: One duo in the middle, 12 rings with 100 opponents slowly closing in, and a jackpot of €50,000. A thrilling battle of wits.
title: Postcode Loterij In de Ring

overview: Residents of The Hague show what connects their city. Genuine locals with big hearts and sharp tongues, and respectable citizens with a sense of style and tradition. Two worlds, but one city.
title: Oh Oh Den Haag

overview: Kick off the weekend with Carrie ten Napel. Carrie welcomes a variety of guests to her clubhouse. In her upbeat Friday show, she chats with them about topics that touch, inspire, and connect us all.
title: Carrie op Vrijdag

overview: Arts in Motion is a thrilling series, showcasing renowned cultural figures sharing their insights with the next generation. This series will encompass multiple disciplines, including dance, music, visual art and performance-based work. Each episode centres around a masterclass led by a major cultural figure working with aspiring artists at the beginning of their careers. This unique opportunity allows young creatives to learn from a world leading artist and refine their craft.
title: Arts in Motion

overview: Blessed with exceptional hearing, blind Roman Mertens lands his dream job in the local police wiretapping unit -- a job more dangerous than he expected.
title: Blind Sherlock

overview: Alex and her team also have to fight to stay afloat because the office is consistently underfunded. Moreover, the cases that arise are deeply affecting Alex and her colleagues. Pro Deo chronicles the lives of Alex and her team, the challenges they face in their personal lives, and how, as an "office family," they not only support each other but also sometimes get in each other's way.
title: Pro Deo

overview: After her husband Thomas's death, Emma discovers that he had registered himself for the allotment garden complex Rust en Vreugd. To cope with her grief, she decided to get a garden after all. It soon became clear that the complex was anything but peaceful and joyful. Before she knew it, Emma was welcomed into the diverse community of gardeners and drawn into a full-blown power struggle over hedge heights, garden bingo, and snail control.
title: Rust en Vreugd

overview: Alpha 00 follows a special team of police specialists who, during the most intense operations, lead a mobile command center at a violent crime scene.
title: Alpha 00

overview: In and around the Noordwijk seaside hotel, the lives of staff, hotel guests, and villagers intertwine – resulting in intrigue, blossoming romance, and unexpected twists. Grand Hotel aan Zee combines beautiful costumes, impressive sets, and delightful characters with timeless themes like love, motherhood, and ambition in the first ever Dutch produced costume drama.
title: Grand Hotel aan Zee

overview: Under the guidance of Ruben Nicolai, twelve participants embark on an adventure full of temptation, strategy, and dilemmas at a mythical location on the Mediterranean Sea. They place their fate in the hands of Pandora's Box. Will the participants manage to curb their curiosity and keep the famous box closed? Or will the temptation prove too strong, with all the consequences that entails?
title: Pandora

overview: Nina is released after three years in prison. An unknown man is waiting for her at the gates of the colony and offers to enter into a fictitious marriage.
title: Выходи за меня замуж!

overview: Join Handyman Hal for a ride on a garbage truck, behind the scenes of a fire station and on a host of fun learning adventures about how things work.
title: Handyman Hal

overview: Dr. Gloria Miralles is a beautiful and successful doctor who seems to have it all. But she has always resented her best friend, Fe Quintero Ruiz, a sweet, sociable literature teacher and an obedient daughter. Two events deepen Gloria's jealousy even more: Fe falls in love with the handsome Sergio Grimán, to whom Gloria is also attracted; and Gloria's mother Alicia drops the bombshell that Fe is actually Gloria's half-sister from past infidelity and is entitled to half her fortune.
title: Los Querendones

overview: Bachelor Vladimir Arkhipov lived peacefully with his faithful mastiff and had no intention of changing anything in his life. Everything happened against his will. His eccentric neighbor, Lizaveta, died, leaving him an apartment and her adopted "orphan girl" as an inheritance. The orphan turned out to be a grown woman named Masha, who stunned the lonely Arkhipov. But why didn't the neighbor leave the apartment to her? Was it because the "Path to Joy" cult was laying claim to it? Then Masha's half-brother from the provinces fell into her care, and then they both disappeared. Concerned about their disappearance and his neighbor's strange death, Arkhipov begins an investigation...
title: Пороки и их поклонники

overview: Three brothers, one spiritual and living at a monastery, the other - a gambler, and the third - an intellectual, work out their problems in 19th century Russia.
title: Братья Карамазовы

overview: Aurora is a modern-day heroine who fights for her freedom and her independence against all those who have plotted against her and imprisoned her. In the background lies a ruthless fight for the homeland, an old feud between rival families, conspiracies, secrets and unspeakable sins, brothers competing for the love of one woman.
title: Le tre rose di Eva

overview: In a remote Russian province in the late nineteenth century, Bishop Mitrofanii must deal with a family crisis. After learning that one of his great aunt's beloved and rare white bulldogs has been poisoned, the Orthodox bishop knows there is only one detective clever enough to investigate the murder: Sister Pelagia. Like a Russian Miss Marple, Sister Pelagia uses her extraordinary intuition to investigate terrible crimes. Based on the best-selling book by Boris Akunin.
title: Пелагия и белый бульдог

overview: It's one of the wealthiest, most beautiful beachside communities in the world and MTV has unlimited access to the tight-knit power clique of eight rich, beautiful teenagers that live there. Their lives intertwine in ways you won't believe, until you drop in for a visit. Laguna Beach is paradise--a little slice of heaven on earth--why would anyone want to leave? The answer will come as you watch the best friends share experiences through parties, relationships, love and small town injustice. This is where the angst and the tumultuous affairs are the stuff of prime time drama, except this is all REAL. And that's just the tip of the iceberg. Welcome to paradise, otherwise known as Laguna Beach, Calif.
title: Laguna Beach: The Real Orange County

overview: Savelyev decides to retire. The boss artificially drags out the process of signing the report, because Savelyev is not only his friend and cool detective, but also a real professional.
title: Кордон следователя Савельева

overview: Tom lives in a world of statistics and figures, while Neil is a true bon vivant and womanizer. These two completely different men turn out to be the perfect team for solving unsolvable crimes. Their qualities are quickly noticed by the ambitious detective Kim, who decides to hire them as consultants.
title: Odds

overview: Criminal profiler Kang Tae Joo is pulled out of retirement by a chilling summons: an imprisoned serial killer has been linked to additional unsolved deaths through DNA evidence, but he insists that Tae Joo joins the investigation, believing that Tae Joo can prove his innocence. Tae Joo is brought back into a world he thought he'd left behind 33 years earlier, forcing him to face ambitious prosecutor Cha Si Young, with whom he shares a difficult past, in pursuit of the truth. But as with many cold cases, the truth isn't as straightforward as it seems – and Tae Joo might be more involved than even he knows. Can Tae Joo finally close the chapter on the "Scarecrow" murders for good, or will a new twist upend his life?
title: Scarecrow

overview: Brian Conley hosts The National Lottery: We've Got Your Number in which members of the public participate in events that revolve round the lottery draw, which takes place during the show.
title: The National Lottery: We've Got Your Number

overview: Gold Wars Downunder follows three hardcore mining teams as they battle it out on the one patch of gold-rich-land to see who can unearth the biggest nuggets and the most gold in an epic made-for-television gold hunting season. The sale of gold is an important source of income for hundreds of thousands of Australians, including the men and women willing to risk it all, as they venture into some of the most dangerous and inhospitable territory on the planet - hoping to strike it rich. The miners are our narrators and through them, and their specialist mining skills, we're drawn into the wider world of remote-area alluvial gold mining. The town of Clermont has estimated gold reserves of $A750 million and the gold price is trading at 10-year historical highs. There's a modern-day gold rush going on in the town of Clermont.
title: Gold Wars Downunder

overview: Millionaire Hot Seat is a fast-paced, tactical twist on the classic format. Hosted by Jeremy Clarkson, the show places six contestants in a rotating "hot seat", demanding quick thinking, strategy and composure under pressure. Six contestants compete in a queue around the Hot Seat. Only the contestant currently in the Hot Seat can answer questions on the money ladder. Answer correctly → climb the ladder Answer incorrectly → you're out, and the top prize drops. Pass → you stay in the game, but return to the back of the queue. Passed questions must be answered by the next player correctly to stay, answer incorrectly and they're out. Only the top remaining prize can be won.
title: Millionaire Hot Seat

overview: Compelling stories are explored every day on This American Life, the nearly 15-year-old, award-winning Chicago Public Radio show that boasts a devoted weekly listening audience of 1.7 million, and is heard on more than 500 stations nationally. The series, created in 1995 by host and executive producer Ira Glass, pioneered a unique way of telling stories on the radio. Its first-person telling of these revealing stories makes the radio series a great fit for television.
title: This American Life

overview: Rick revisits his Aussie home from home. Catching up with old friends and foodie favourites, he explores exciting new dishes, from the arid Outback to the dazzling Sapphire Coast.
title: Rick Stein's Australia

overview: A stylish arrangement in a modern way of a number of classic love stories - "Carmen", "Orpheus and Eurydice", "Don Quixote", "Cyrano de Bergerac", "Hamlet". Each episode is a complete story with its own characters, they are united only by the place of action - the city of Rostov-on-Don. It is always summer here, women are beautiful and men are courageous, there is a high sky and a blue river, everyone is happy here or could be happy.
title: Ростов-Папа

overview: The historical drama "Toussaint Louverture" is dedicated to the fate of Toussaint Louverture, the leader of the Haitian Revolution, as a result of which Haiti became the first independent state in Latin America.
title: Toussaint Louverture

overview: Pasha Gaitan and Oleg Lyalakin, ordinary employees of the teaching staff, dream of becoming real "bounty hunters" and independently fight criminals, especially for a decent remuneration. The day comes when fate itself forces them to take up this trade: would-be friends are thrown out of the police with a bang.
title: Назначена награда

overview: Adventurous naturalist and all round snake lover Nigel Marven takes a look at some of the world's most lethal snakes.
title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven

overview: This entertaining two-part social experiment sees presenter Josie Gibson immerse herself in the food, drink and health culture of the 1970s, to discover if the average diet from what is often seen as one of the "unhealthiest" decades in British history, could have something to teach modern eaters. For two weeks, Josie follows a bespoke 1970s diet, carefully designed by a nutritional expert, to reflect what the average person would have eaten in that decade. She'll take a series of physiological tests before and after to see if the 70s diet and lifestyle can make her slimmer, fitter and healthier.
title: The 1970s Diet: Could It Work for You?

overview: American Casino is an American reality television series which tracks the daily events of the managers and employees of the Green Valley Ranch Casino resort in Henderson, Nevada, a suburb of Las Vegas.
title: American Casino

overview: Fatal Fall: Murder or Accident is a shocking series built on a chilling premise: each episode examines a case where a victim was seemingly pushed to their death — from balconies and rooftops to cliffs, staircases, and bridges. Beyond the act itself, the series explores the interpersonal tensions and psychological buildup that led to these sudden and violent outcomes, often at the hands of someone they knew and loved, and the investigations that followed. Through expert analysis and testimony from those closest to the victims, the series reveals how ordinary moments can turn deadly in an instant, and asks the ultimate questions: who can you truly trust, what really happened, and why.
title: Fatal Fall: Murder or Accident

overview: Twelve famous Swedes are isolated in a luxury suite at the top of a skyscraper. Monitored 24/7, they navigate a brutal power game where cunning, pacts and betrayal are necessary to avoid being voted out. The rules of the game are simple – but unfair. Both power and money influence the participants in the mini-society created in the suite. One by one, they are ruthlessly voted out by the group until only one winner remains.
title: Spelet

overview: We follow the Robinson participants as they leave the great adventure, from the moment they board the boat to the first bite of real food.
title: Robinson - Exit

overview: Talap, a beautiful slave girl was raped by her master Manas. As a result, his first wife Thanthip hates her. Pregnant from the assault, Talap's child ends up dying after delivery as the result of Thanthip's vengeance. In retaliation, Talap decides to take away Thanthip's own daughter. As time passes, the abducted young girl grows into a beautiful young woman. Now Talap plans on bringing the father and daughter into a forbidden relationship for the ulitmate revenge.
title: Lueat Kakee

overview: The story is about Forest Conservation. The main lead are special agents from the National Forest Ranger Department.
title: Hua Jai Patapee

overview: The murder mystery of the business tycoon Paisarn leads his children to come face to face again. Including Ansaya who is about to become the newest member of the family. But… the first case hasn't been solved, a new case arises that made her and Paam, Jao Sua's younger brother and also her first love become suspects. Their love then rekindles in the midst of danger and the real murderer that no one suspected.
title: Roi Arkart

overview: David Rea works as Emotional Trainer dealing with all kinds of people in existential block.
title: STUCK: The Chronicles of David Rea

overview: Islands born of fire run from the equatorial Atlantic down to Antarctica. Many are now home to unique species and all have intriguing stories to tell.
title: Unseen Islands

overview: Life and love of ladies man Joao, while lab outside of town does experiments on lizards and people.
title: O Sorriso do Lagarto

overview: Ozie Boo! tells the story of five baby penguins, four boys and a girl, who learn to cohabit in a joyous and friendly way and have many adventures in their home, located in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.
title: Ozie Boo!

overview: On the surface, they're barbers, but behind the scenes, they're... Ryoshi! A retro-style barbershop tucked away in a rural town. The two men who work there have hidden lives. "For 3 million yen, we'll straighten up your life." The Ryoshi take on any problem that can't be solved in the real world, straightening out their clients' messy lives and cutting their hair. This mysterious barbershop, run by two clumsy men, will once again see someone off to a fresh start.
title: Oretachi Bad Barbers
